final: SELECT s.City, COUNT(*) AS magnet_k8_schools, SUM(CASE WHEN f.`NSLP Provision Status` = 'Multiple Provision Types' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multiple_provision_schools, COUNT(*) OVER () AS number_of_cities, SUM(SUM(CASE WHEN f.`NSLP Provision Status` = 'Multiple Provision Types' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) OVER () AS total_multiple_provision_schools FROM schools AS s LEFT JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode WHERE s.Magnet = 1 AND s.GSserved = 'K-8' GROUP BY s.City ORDER BY s.City
